guideIntro: Follow a short path through advice, history, timed irrigation, results and a schedule. The guide only navigates.
stepAdvice: Advice uses the latest available data. Soil status labels and irrigation presets use different boundaries.
stepHistory: Open the zone history to review its readings.
stepIrrigation: Find the timed irrigation control. Opening it is your choice.
stepSkip: Use the farm-time control to move to the next event.
stepSchedule: Open schedules and inspect when a run is set to start.
stepNext: Continue exploring or learn more about OSI OS.
